text:
Calgary comes to Seattle after a 2-1 win in San Jose, where William Stromgren scored his first NHL goal, and with Connor Zary and Samuel Honzek out. Seattle hasn't played since losing 6-2 in Calgary five days ago, its third lopsided result against the Flames this season, and is missing Jared McCann. With McCann out, Jordan Eberle has moved beside Matty Beniers and Mackie Samoskevich, Beniers has taken a first power-play spot, and Shane Wright is up to 16:31 a night from 12:52.

Neither team has controlled play. At five on five, Calgary has taken 46% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) and Seattle 45%. Calgary's record looks worse than its play: it has scored 3.3 fewer goals than its chances usually produce and allowed 4.1 more than expected. Calgary also takes 4.3 penalties a game against a Seattle power play averaging 0.59 expected goals. In net, projected starters Dustin Wolf (-6.3 goals saved above expected) and Philipp Grubauer (-1.5) are both underwater this season, though Grubauer was 5.4 above expected last year and Wolf 2.8 below.

Eberle (28% to score) and Joel Farabee (26%, 56% for a point) top our lists. Morgan Frost, picked 27th by Philadelphia in 2017, is a point shy of 200. We like Ryan Strome as an under-the-radar pick: his shots have been dangerous lately, and we have him at 16% to score against a goalie allowing more than his shots deserve.
